profile.headline: Senior Security Software Engineer
profile.jobTitle: Senior Software Engineer in Security at Microsoft
profile.summary:
I bring over a decade of deep expertise in software engineering, cybersecurity, and cloud infrastructure. My career spans roles in both private and public sectors, where I’ve led full-stack development teams, directed cybersecurity initiatives, and taught future technologists as an adjunct faculty member. I’ve developed mission-critical software in Python, Java, and C++, and have consistently been trusted to secure complex environments at leading organizations.

I hold premier certifications including CISSP, OSCP, CompTIA Security+, and multiple Microsoft Azure credentials, demonstrating a robust command of both offensive and defensive security. My most recent certifications in Terraform and AI Fundamentals reflect my forward-looking approach to DevSecOps and machine learning integration. I thrive at the intersection of cloud engineering, cybersecurity strategy, and leadership while helping enterprises safeguard their systems and accelerating innovation. Let’s connect and build the future of secure technology together.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer in Security at Microsoft
Adjunct Faculty
positions.description:
Taught Introductory Computer Sciences courses including C++ and Java programming courses
Created and graded Homework Assignments, Projects, and Exams
Provided additional tutoring services during evenings and weekends

positions.title: Associate
positions.description:
Developed software in python and C++ to support mission critical projects that directly impact national security and intelligence missions
Led cross organizational collaboration to share and build testing suite code base to satisfy multiple organizational requirements
Tested software solutions to support mission critical national security projects administered linux based servers that hosted testing suite software

positions.title: Cyber Analyst
positions.description:
Contributed to and coordinated on the production of reports based on intelligence information 
Compiled, integrated, and interpreted all-source data for intelligence or vulnerability value with respect to targets

positions.title: Cyber Operator
positions.description:
Conducted Computer Network Exploitation (CNE) in order to fulfill critical national level requirements in support of foreign intelligence efforts
Analyzed networks in order to identify and assess vulnerabilities to enable and conduct CNE operations
Maintained operational, technical and authoritative situational awareness during operations
Kept abreast of emerging technologies and advancements in computer network exploitation

positions.title: Information Technology Specialist
positions.description:
Developed custom web applications and solutions utilizing C#/ASP.NET Framework, SQL Server and industry standard web technologies
Collaborated with Computer Network Defense (CND) Analysts to optimize processes and IT resources
Planned, designed, developed custom Sharepoint solutions for 2007/2010 instances
